info.name: Hollow Knight Silksong YouTube Theme
info.description: Transform YouTube with the ethereal beauty of Hollow Knight Silksong! This style features deep blues, elegant greens, silvery accents, and bug-inspired motifs that bring the atmosphere of Pharloom to your viewing experience. Enjoy Silksong-themed backgrounds, custom buttons, and elegant typography inspired by Team Cherry's masterpiece.
info.additionalInfo:
? Hollow Knight Silksong YouTube Theme v1.0

Bring the ethereal beauty of Pharloom to your YouTube experience!

Features:
✨ Deep blue and teal gradient backgrounds inspired by Silksong's atmosphere
✨ Elegant serif typography (Cinzel/Trajan Pro fallback)
✨ Silvery white text with golden accents for important elements
✨ Purple subscribe buttons with gold borders
✨ Custom styled scrollbars, buttons, and input fields
✨ Subtle bug motifs (butterfly emoji decorations)
✨ Smooth hover effects and transitions
✨ Themed video thumbnails, sidebar, and comments section

Color Palette:
- Dark Blue: #0a1628
- Deep Blue: #1a2845  
- Accent Blue: #2d4a7c
- Teal: #4a7c7c
- Silver: #c8d3e0
- White: #e8f0f7
- Purple: #6b5b8c
- Gold: #d4af37

Note: This theme is fully customizable! Feel free to tweak the CSS variables in the :root section to adjust colors to your preference. Works on all YouTube pages including home, video player, channels, and search results.

Inspired by Team Cherry's masterpiece. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Team Cherry.
